_about: Parameters for the two explorers in this folder. Every entry is copied verbatim (value + unit + source) from ../constants.json, which traces each number to book.pdf (section + table) or the L4 KEY-LEARNINGS.md. Nothing here is retyped from prose; load this file. Where an explorer needs a value constants.json does not carry as a scalar (e.g. a compute roof for a precision the book reports per datapath), the source string names the note/table it was lifted from and labels any derivation 'estimate'. Rung 3 (learn-explorer).
